segments.text: This girl makes the last mistake of her life, drinking this clear glacial water in Antarctica.
And three days later, she was urgently taken to the hospital, where she died.
But what's wrong with this glacial water?
At first glance, this water looks like the purest liquid that exists on the planet, and
many tourists try to try it, of course, and they don't even realize how much they risk.
In fact, behind the transparency of this water, there are many dangers invisible to the eyes.
The thing is, that this water comes from ancient glaciers in Antarctica, that are several tens
of millions of years old, and every drop of this frozen water is like a time capsule,
and the age of this water exceeds the age when those very dinosaurs walk the earth.
But the most frightening thing is that if you start studying this water under a microscope,
you can see ancient bacteria and parasites there, which are also older than those very
dinosaurs, and people just don't have immunity from these ancient organisms.
And this blogger didn't know about it either, and what happened to him after taking a sip
of this water was shocking, you can take a look at it yourself by searching for TikTok
for the last sip of glacial water.
